svg.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
svg.title: TurtlePen native editing

g.aria-label: text title: Exact edits. Recoverable work.
text subtitle: Every shape below comes from native TurtlePen operations.
g.text: Every shape below comes from native TurtlePen operations.

g.aria-label: text transform-label: 01 Mirror and quarter turns
text transform-caption: One source. Explicit copies. Exact lattice pivots.
g.text: One source. Explicit copies. Exact lattice pivots.

g.aria-label: text cut-label: 02 Shape cut and radial color
text cut-caption: Both partitions survive. Color is stored in the pieces.
g.text: Both partitions survive. Color is stored in the pieces.

g.aria-label: text guide-caption: The guide is gone; the snapped artwork stays.
g.text: The guide is gone; the snapped artwork stays.

g.aria-label: text array-caption: Named quarter-turn copies; the source is retained.
g.text: Named quarter-turn copies; the source is retained.

g.aria-label: text footer: Plan -> edit -> inspect -> undo / redo -> reopen -> verify
g.text: Plan -> edit -> inspect -> undo / redo -> reopen -> verify

g.aria-label: text footer-note: Construction guides prevent release even when hidden. Rich timeline exports report unsupported fields.
g.text: Construction guides prevent release even when hidden. Rich timeline exports report unsupported fields.
